features.name: xNudge Balkan Wild

review:
The office sequel on a 4x5 grid. Infectious xWays reveal stacks of two to four symbols – or a blocker – and Elevator symbols reveal an instant bonus or a blocker in the base game, and extra spins in the bonus.

The xNudge Balkan Wild can land anywhere and nudge with a growing multiplier. Extreme volatility, 11,111x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
